verdict.rationale: Jitsu is an event-collection pipeline, so data retention and deletion is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence documents no retention settings, deletion API, or user/data-erasure capability. Event filtering before delivery, self-hosting and warehouse-side storage are adjacent controls or host-platform capabilities, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
